rationale.automation-bias: Workers offload to AI and avoid modifications when under review accountability.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Requiring AI logs alongside final submissions mitigates workers' offloading to AI.
rationale.counterpoint: Argues against the assumption that review accountability decreases outsourcing to AI.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Reports empirical results on worker offloading and evaluates process visibility mitigation.
